description: Load the coordinator rules only into coordinator sessions (SPLIT_ORCHESTRATOR_ROLE=coordinator, or role unset/empty and a run record present; any other nonempty role gets none), again after resume and compaction

args: case "${SPLIT_ORCHESTRATOR_ROLE:-}" in coordinator) cat "$1" ;; '') if ls "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"/artifacts/*/run.md >/dev/null 2>&1; then cat "$1"; fi ;; esac
